name: GPT-5.6 Terra
short: OpenAI's balanced tier (1.05M/128K, $2/$12) for coding and research; TB 2.1 87.4%, SWE-Pro 63.4%, MRCR 72.5% at 512K-1M.
modalities: Text, image, audio, video, PDF in; text out
pricingNote: Paid $2/$12 per 1M; default free quota in Codex
standout: The balanced all-rounder of OpenAI’s 5.6 line — dependable across coding, research and very long context recall without flagship pricing.
tradeoff: It deliberately tops out below the Sol specialists: for peak coding or peak reasoning, the pricier siblings win.
freeTierNote: Default model for free & Go tier users in OpenAI Codex with monthly quota limits; API is paid $2/$12
pricingTiers: Included monthly quota on Codex (Free / Go plans)
